topic.title: Installation Guide
topic.shortdesc: Step-by-step guide to installing the XSmartHomeHub device.

body.p: To install the XSmartHomeHub, unbox the unit and connect it to a power source using the provided adapter.
Next, use an Ethernet cable to connect it to your router, or use the mobile app to configure Wi-Fi settings.
Ensure the LED indicator lights up, signaling that the hub is powered and ready for configuration.
